notes.title: The DATA_BREAK hero (and his cat) Now Playable in Swarmcade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881925/a9025f681d13efa002fd06c4d95fb3451eb63c87.png[/img]

The hero of DATA_BREAK (and his cat) makes an appearance as a hidden playable character in the demo of upcoming roguelite [b]Swarmcade[/b], also developed by Giggles Games. 

Can you unlock the duo? Try the demo for Swarmcade here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146490/Swarmcade/

And here's a trailer for the game:

[previewyoutube=KGY8IpzfBCg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Play the Demo! OBEY! OBEY! OBEY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881925/7b39d3506eb3b464575915cb46130053edb20c77.gif[/img]

In October 2022, the DATA_BREAK demo released as part of the Steam Next Fest. We were delighted that almost 6000 people have added it to their Steam accounts to date! 

However out of those almost 6000, only a few hundred have actually installed and played. So just a reminder to give it a try if you haven't. And if you like it, please remember to wish list!

We cannot guarantee the current demo will remain live indefinitely, so grab it in case it goes (those who have already installed will still be able to play regardless.)

notes.content:
New demo patch:

notes.title: DATA_BREAK @ Steam Next Fest & Demo update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881925/987f666af2ee615d5267a84d1106f568b1e2e80e.png[/img]

We're fashionably late, but DATA_BREAK is now part of the Steam October Next Fest. If you haven't already, give the demo a try. If you livestream it, feel free to leave a link in the comments.

For those that have already completed the demo, we'll be adding an update soon which adds new achievements and some new things, if you can find them...
